stage0021_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
Spectator
「So those two debut today, huh.
　But thrown into a《$$リアルバトル$$》 right off...
　and a battle royale on top of that」

stage0021_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
Spectator
「But there's a Berzelga among them.
　Means there's a Kuent native in the mix」

stage0021_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
Spectator
「Their skill's the real deal.
　If I'm betting, it's got to be him」

stage0021_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
Spectator
「Amateur!
　I'm putting it all on that white AS!
　That thing's no ordinary machine!」

stage0021_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
Spectator
「Who's the amateur here!
　Flashy looks like that usually mean
　the pilot doesn't trust their own skill!」

stage0021_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
Spectator
「Speaking of looks, what about the blue one?」

stage0021_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
Spectator
「That's not an AT, AS, or KMF.
　Going by size, is it a Mobile Suit?」

stage0021_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
Spectator
「Might be a dark horse, that one.
　Guess I'll put a little on them too」

stage0021_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
Spectator
「Probably just there to fill the roster.
　That one's the first to go down」

stage0021_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$マオ$$
「You hear that, $$キリコ$$?
　That's what the crowd thinks of you two」

stage0021_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Heh... it's suckers like that
　that keep our pockets full」

stage0021_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Naturally, all in on $$キリコ$$」

stage0021_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$クルツ$$...
　you refused to sortie
　just to bet on $$キリコ$$, didn't you?」

stage0021_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Come on, Boss.
　$n's the one who said
　they wanted to enter $$バトリング$$」

stage0021_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$マオ$$
「I respect their wish to get stronger,
　but our foes are seasoned veterans」

stage0021_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$マオ$$
「On top of that, it's a battle royale.
　Slip up once and they'll gang up, instant kill」

stage0021_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Guess we pray Miss $$スズネ$$
　can keep that under control」

stage0021_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$n
「You said $$バトリング$$ wasn't for me.
　But I have a reason to fight」

stage0021_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$キリコ$$
「By shutting a lid on your own heart?」

stage0021_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$キリコ$$
「It's not just about $$バトリング$$.
　You're not cut out to fight」

stage0021_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「That's enough.
　The other fighters are coming soon」

stage0021_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$バニラ$$
「$$シャッコ$$!
　I've got money on you, don't let me down!」

stage0021_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ココナ$$
「Cut it out, all of you, $$バニラ$$, $$クルツ$$, old man!
　$$キリコ$$ and the others are on a mission!」

stage0021_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$マオ$$
「It's fine, $$ココナ$$.
　Infiltrating $$バトリング$$ to scout things out
　from the inside, that's the mission」

stage0021_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$マオ$$
「So we'd better act the part too,
　here in the stands」

stage0021_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So, Boss, who are you backing?」

stage0021_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$マオ$$
「Sousuke.
　He's shrewd in times like this」

stage0021_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Out of pity, $$ココナ$$.
　Put something on them, will you」

stage0021_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ココナ$$
「No way!
　I've put everything on $$キリコ$$!」

stage0021_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Come on!
　You went and bet too after all!」

stage0021_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Quit it, you two!
　Look, the other fighters are entering!」

stage0021_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$スズネ$$
「A battle royale means everyone's an enemy...
　Only the last one standing wins」

stage0021_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$n
「That AT pilot at the front... are they laughing?」

stage0021_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Broadcasting that on external speakers...
　A strange hobby」

stage0021_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
???
「Hahahahaha!
　I have waited for this moment!」

stage0021_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「That's right, $$キリコ$$, $$シャッコ$$!
　Your commanding officer, $$カン・ユー$$!」

stage0021_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Looks like a real attention hog showed up」

stage0021_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$バニラ$$
「That's $$カン・ユー$$.
　$$キリコ$$ and $$シャッコ$$'s old commander
　from their mercenary days, a nasty piece of work」

stage0021_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$バニラ$$
「He was such scum that in the end
　$$キリコ$$ and the others abandoned him,
　and now he's holding a grudge over it」

stage0021_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$マオ$$
「Some reunions are happy, some a headache...
　$$ア・コバ$$ earns its name as a drifters' den」

stage0021_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Can you hear me, $$キリコ$$!
　No greeting for your reunited commander!」

stage0021_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
Spectator
「A mic performance, huh!
　Really gets the crowd going!」

stage0021_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
Spectator
「A grudge match kicking off!
　Now I'm fired up!」

stage0021_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$!
　When I heard you and $$シャッコ$$
　were entering $$バトリング$$, I was overjoyed!」

stage0021_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Ever since the $$新世時空震動$$
　scattered me from my men, I've known
　nothing but hardship, but luck has finally struck!」

stage0021_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$スズネ$$
「S-$$宗介$$... let's at least hear him out」

stage0021_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Today I settle this, $$キリコ$$!
　In this $$バトリング$$, you and your friends will die!」

stage0021_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ココナ$$
「What are you even saying, it's a battle royale!」

stage0021_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$マオ$$
「Seems like the other fighters
　have all been bought off by that $$カン・ユー$$ guy」

stage0021_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$バニラ$$
「So it's $$キリコ$$ and the others against that whole mob!」

stage0021_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ココナ$$
「That's not fair!
　This match should be void!」

stage0021_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「No, it's too late for that now.
　Even the organizers fear a riot,
　so they can't cancel it at this point」

stage0021_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Tch! For $$カン・ユー$$,
　that's a slick move he's pulled!」

stage0021_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$n
「I'll prove I can fight my own way」

stage0021_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$宗介$$
「This too is a battlefield.
　I will not tolerate being lectured
　by a third-rater with a petty grudge」

stage0021_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$n
「So basically, you two are fired up too」

stage0021_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$マオ$$
「Then the bets change!
　Whichever team wins, its top scorer
　is the winner of this match!」

stage0021_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
Spectator
「Got it!
　Works for us, Boss!」

stage0021_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
Spectator
「Alright!
　Don't you lose, blue one!」

stage0021_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you insolent...!
　Just how far will you mock me!」

stage0021_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I was going to spare everyone
　but $$キリコ$$ and $$シャッコ$$, forget it! Forget it!
　I'll kill every last one of you!」

stage0021_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Nguhhh!
　All units, begin attack!」

stage0021_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
Spectator
「No way!
　That plain old Dog came out on top!」

stage0021_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
Spectator
「N-no way...!
　Don't tell me he's a $$レッドショルダー$$!」

stage0021_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$クルツ$$
「We did it, old man, $$ココナ$$!
　That's easy money!」

stage0021_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ココナ$$
「Hahaha! Course it was gonna go that way!
　It's $$キリコ$$, after all!」

stage0021_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「No kidding!
　Ever since we first met in the Ghetto,
　I knew he'd make us money!」

stage0021_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Thanks a ton, $$キリコ$$!
　I'll chip in for your girl's medicine!」

stage0021_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$マオ$$
「This isn't the time to get excited, $$クルツ$$!」

stage0021_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
Spectator
「Yeah! That's a Quentian for you!
　You're number one!」

stage0021_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$バニラ$$
「The old man gets it, huh!
　When it comes down to it, you can
　always count on that guy!」

stage0021_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Don't sulk, $$クルツ$$.
　I'll cover your drinks tonight at least!」

stage0021_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$マオ$$
「This isn't the time to be so laid-back!」

stage0021_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「No way!
　The top spot goes to the silent sergeant!」

stage0021_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$マオ$$
「Well done, Sousuke!
　You're a subordinate I'm proud of!」

stage0021_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
Spectator
「Damn it...!
　And here I'm broke because of this!」

stage0021_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$マオ$$
「Don't make such a sour face!
　Tonight's on me, so let's have a blast!」

stage0021_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
Spectator
「Yahoo!
　You're the goddess of $$ア・コバ$$!」

stage0021_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Yeah, what the hell!
　We'll take you up on the free drinks too!」

stage0021_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$マオ$$
「...Doesn't look like the time for that!」

stage0021_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「The top spot goes to that $n!」

stage0021_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$マオ$$
「Don't say that.
　That kid did their best in their own way.」

stage0021_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ココナ$$
「Says the one who was slinging filthy
　language just a minute ago.」

stage0021_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ココナ$$
「W-what!
　I'm just telling the truth!」

stage0021_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$マオ$$
「That's not it...!
　This might be bad news!」

stage0021_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
Spectator
「What happens if there's a tie for first...!?」

stage0021_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$マオ$$
「No hard feelings, it's probably void...」

stage0021_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What kind of ending is that!
　That's the most boring one there is!」

stage0021_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$マオ$$
「Quit your griping.
　The fighters gave it their all.」

stage0021_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$マオ$$
「Especially you, who skipped the sortie.
　You've got no right to say anything.」

stage0021_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah, well, that's true, but still!」

stage0021_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$マオ$$
「That's enough griping.
　Looks like things are getting messy...!」

stage0021_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$スズネ$$
「With the Earth Federation's reorganization,
　the $$アストラギウス$$ Gilgamesh and Balarant forces
　should have been absorbed into the Federation...」

stage0021_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$宗介$$
「No Federation ID signal from the enemy ahead.」

stage0021_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$n
「So basically, they're just thugs
　who use $$ア・コバ$$ as their turf...!」

stage0021_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「So they're making their move.」

stage0021_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$宗介$$
「Do they mean to crush us for disrupting
　the $$バトリング$$, or are they the ones behind $$ア・コバ$$?」

stage0021_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$クルツ$$
「OK, you guys!
　Leave the rest to us!」

stage0021_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$n
（Weren't you just watching the $$バトリング$$
　a second ago? Look who's talking...）

stage0021_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$宗介$$
（That's the man, $$クルツ・ウェーバー$$.）

stage0021_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Skull Leader to all units!
　Looks like Balarant forces and mercenaries,
　since they're not Federation, they're a militia!」

stage0021_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$オズマ$$
「If they want a fight, we'll give them one!」

stage0021_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I see...
　Londo Bell and Super Robots aren't cut
　out for a mission like this.」

stage0021_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$クラン$$
「Then we must live up to the expectations
　of the $$ミスリル$$ that requested $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$!」

stage0021_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$宗介$$! Leave the enemy air power to us!
　You and $$キリコ$$'s group hit the AS and armor!」

stage0021_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$$キリコ$$ and $$シャッコ$$, $$宗介$$ and $n,
　form up into teams!」

stage0021_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin the attack.
　I don't want any needless trouble.
　Let's finish this quickly.」

stage0021_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Confirmed, the enemy unit has been wiped out.」

stage0021_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Judging by the pilots who ejected,
　they're likely Balarant personnel after all.」

stage0021_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「An $$アストラギウス$$ unit outside the Federation...」

stage0021_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Major, do you have an idea?」

stage0021_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「At this point it's only a guess.
　Let's keep gathering information.」

stage0021_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Understood.
　Order all units to return.」

stage0021_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Found you, $$レッドショルダー$$.」

stage0021_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Damn you, $$キリコ$$!
　Today was just a probe!
　Next time, I'll finish you for good!」

stage0021_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That person... they must have come here
　to settle things with $$キリコ$$...」

stage0021_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$n
「There's no need to take that kind of
　person's sour grapes seriously.」

stage0021_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$宗介$$
「Even $$キリコ$$ doesn't seem to be listening at all.」

stage0021_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$!
　The day I finally settle things with you has come!」

stage0021_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Th-that attitude of yours is unforgivable!
　Cry, beg for your life, do something!」

stage0021_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$キリコ$$
「There's no need to do that for someone like you.」

stage0021_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「It's not too late, even now, $$シャッコ$$!
　Apologize to me, and I might forgive you!」

stage0021_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「I've no head to bow to a man like you.」

stage0021_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「You'd defy your superior officer to the end!?」

stage0021_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Just when do you think this is?
　I can't be bothered with this.」

stage0021_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「An AS I've never seen before!
　This one looks worth crushing!」

stage0021_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you're ignoring me too!?
　Just like $$キリコ$$!」

stage0021_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$宗介$$
「A natural response for a soldier.
　Something you, who chatters uselessly
　on the battlefield, wouldn't understand.」

stage0021_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「So you're their weak point!
　I'll deal with you first!」

stage0021_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$n
「I know that without you telling me...!
　But so what!?」

stage0021_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Wh-what is this!?
　Throwing caution to the wind!?」

stage0021_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$n
「I'm not being reckless!
　I don't plan on dying before that day comes!」

stage0021_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Let's go, you guys!
　I'm in top form today!」

stage0021_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Thanks, $$キリコ$$!
　Thanks to you, I'll have good dreams tonight!」

stage0021_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$マオ$$
「Heh... thanks to Sousuke,
　today's beer is going to be the best.」

stage0021_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$マオ$$
「But first, I need to work up a good sweat!
　You lot are going to be my sparring partners!」

stage0021_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$n
（I can do this...!
　I'm getting stronger...!）

stage0021_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$n
（Whether I'm suited for battle or not, who cares...!
　I have no choice but to fight!）
